'''Greg Shaw''' (DeckTech handle '''TychoCelchu''', GEMP handle '''shaw67193''')<ref name="roster">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=81218 SWCCG Teams - Rosters], Joe Olson (21 July 2022; spreadsheet updated 14 September 2025). [[:File:SWCCG Teams Rosters 14 September 2025.txt]]; [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit Google Sheet]; Wayback [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008235350/https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit?usp=sharing 8 October 2026]</ref><ref name="dt-26555">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/26555 Force Lightning is TECH], DeckTech (Greg "TychoCelchu" Shaw, 10 December 2002)</ref> is a member of [[New Allies]] and the 2025 World Champion. He finished 2nd at the [[2003 World Championship]] and the [[2002 World Championship]] and '''#7''' at the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]] (Lost Quarterfinals (Top 8); Challonge seed 3).<ref name="pc-gempc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-06-tenth-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2026/ 2026-06 Tenth Annual GEMPC], starwarsccg.org</ref><ref name="challonge">[https://challonge.com/18vokbxb Challonge 18vokbxb]</ref>
